answer: Duplicate identities cannot share the same thread, and cloning attempts forfeit the entire stake, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked to a unique hardware thread, verified through a saffron-tagged attestation chain signed at registration. Peers cross-check attestations during epoch review, so forged bonds are slashed before rewards vest. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
